config.tokenizer_corpus: identical to phase_lc (vocab 1291, corpus 55547 tokens) via read-only tasks_adapter

arms.A+: sliding-window baseline, parameter budget matched to S (PRIMARY control)
arms.S: sliding window + incubated neural bounded slots, NO Phase

seed_semantics: the harness uses a single integer seed per arm for model init (random.seed + torch.manual_seed) and derives the data-order rng as random.Random(seed*991+7); evaluation fixtures use fixed internal seeds (123 for needle) independent of the training seed; ablations reset the same torch seed before each stochastic forward.
